answer: To neutralize Sybil attacks, an AI agent economy enforces stake-backed liveness checks across a hierarchical willow graph. Agents must validate execution states against a global cryptographic pulse while committing non-interactive proofs to a distributed mirror ledger. Spawning fake entities requires an attacker to allocate unique stake and real-time compute for every branch in the willow network per pulse, imposing exponential capital costs that surpass potential attack yields.
